title: Umyili Weebhongo Ezingeyonyani
intro: Umntu owayenegunya elikhulu wayekhonza omnye wabalawuli abadumileyo kwimbali yaseYiputa yamandulo. Lo mntu wayenikwe umyalelo onesibindi - wokwakha isakhiwo esenzelwe ukuchasa amazulu. Ibali labo limi kwiQuran njengesifundo esichukumisayo malunga nendlela ukuthobela ngokungaboniyo ikratshi okukhokelela ngayo ekutshabalaleni.
clues: Ndakhonza kwiinkundla zomlawuli onamandla owayesithi ndinguthixo phezu kwamazwe.
Bendinesikhundla esiphezulu njengomfundisi, ndicebisa umlawuli okhohlakeleyo owayenekratshi kwixesha lam.
Umlawuli wam wayexakeke kakhulu kukuchasa uThixo kaMoses, lowo bala ukumqonda.
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndakhe inqaba yezitena ezitshiswe ngomlilo ukuze umlawuli wam akwazi ukunyuka aye ezulwini.
Inqaba ayizange ifikelele esibhakabhakeni, kwaye ukukhotyokiswa kwam likratshi kwandizisela ihlazo elingunaphakade.
Ndatshabalala kunye nalowo ndandimlandela, igama lam laba sisilumkiso esihlala sihleli nxamnye nabo bavumela oozwilakhe ukuba balawule.
